content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CMRL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CMRL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) for filling up various managerial and technical posts across different departments on a contract basis in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available in CMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 to 7 vacancies advertised under notification CMRL-HR-CON-DEP-05-2026 for various posts including Joint General Manager, Manager, and Assistant Manager positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for various posts under CMRL recruitment is 13 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for CMRL Manager posts?
faq.answer: The required qualifications vary by post, including B.E/B.Tech in Civil or ECE/EEE, degrees with CA/CMA for finance roles, and specialized M.E/M.Tech degrees for transport planning roles.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range offered by Chennai Metro Rail?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly pay ranging from Rs. 62,000/- for assistant manager positions up to Rs. 1,45,000/- for joint general manager positions.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to CMRL positions?
faq.answer: Yes, unreserved and other categories need to pay Rs. 300/-, SC/ST candidates pay Rs. 50/-, while differently-abled persons are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CMRL recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises a personal interview followed by a comprehensive medical examination to assess the candidate's fitness for the designated role.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for CMRL various posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply exclusively through the online mode by visiting the official CMRL careers portal, registering with a valid email ID, and uploading necessary documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the maximum age limit for Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Assistant Manager (Design) and Assistant Manager (Transport Planning) positions is capped at 30 years as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online links?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to download the official notification PDF and access the online application portal in the Important Links section of this article.
